summary: The turtle module draws by moving a pen around the window. You fill shapes by drawing them between begin_fill() and end_fill().
notes: penup() before goto() moves the pen without drawing a line.
pen.color("orange", "gold") sets the outline color first and the fill color second.
write() places text at the pen's position. align="center" centers it there.
pitfall: Leaving out turtle.done() at the end makes the window close as soon as the drawing finishes, or never respond to the close button.
